scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Saturday's public fare-card clinic able to run its listed hands-on kiosk-practice station.
Emerging Need: The clinic becomes public with the practice station included, but the station still lacks the agency demo reader it must use instead of live rider accounts.
Decision Context: Tote checks and agency manifest notices clarify that no reader is already secured; stored resource records identify the allowable no-cost loan source, custodian, and courier cutoff.
Consequence: If the prerequisite is lined up before manifest lock, the station remains feasible without account access or spending; afterward, the clinic can proceed only as verbal guidance.

parameter.title: Fare-card clinic planning hold
parameter.description: Internal hold for a possible public fare-card help clinic; activity details pending partner confirmation.

parameter.subject: Saturday fare-card clinic listing
parameter.body: We posted the public listing for Saturday, August 1, 10:00-12:00 in Room A. The listing includes a hands-on kiosk-practice station along with the neutral help table. The north-wall table will stay on the setup sheet unless changes arrive before 15:20 today.

parameter.content: I checked the outreach tote for Saturday: lanyard sleeves, blank cards, and table signs are there, but there is no agency demo fare-card reader. We can still do paper Q&A, but the kiosk-practice station would need that reader.

parameter.subject: Demo reader manifest status
parameter.body: Today's clinic-loaner manifest closes at 15:30. Harborview coalition is not on the demo-reader reservation list as of 14:00, and readers not listed on the manifest will not be packed for tomorrow's courier bin.

parameter.subject: Demo reader manifest closed
parameter.body: The 15:30 clinic-loaner manifest is locked. Unreserved demo readers have been assigned to Monday staff training and will not be included in tomorrow's courier bin for Saturday clinics.
